ModMetaData.name: Grenade Stack Counter Fix
ModMetaData.author: Allen / Rimworld-Project
ModMetaData.description: Fixes RimWorld 1.5 bill target-count inventory counting for the stackable medieval grenades DankPyon_Weapon_PotFire, DankPyon_Weapon_PotFlash, DankPyon_Weapon_PotFlashSmoke, and DankPyon_Weapon_AcidFlask. Vanilla counts map Thing instances for non-resource products, which undercounts stackable weapons. This patch sums stackCount only for those four grenade defs.
